referenceTitle: Sovereign dietary-supplement heavy-metal maximum levels (Thailand, GCC, Israel, Vietnam)
reason: Grouped reference remains unresolved: Thailand Notification 414 is identifiable and its FAO-hosted unofficial English translation gives supplement lead 1 mg/kg as prepared for consumption; GSO 193:2021 catalog identity was found but its paid numerical table was not read; Israel “FCS-2016” could not be tied to an exact primary instrument; the official Vietnamese QCVN 8-2:2011/BYT PDF could not be consistently retrieved for a verified numerical read. Do not silently replace the Israeli instrument or publish this four-country grouping as fully reviewed. None of the partial reads establishes a universal adult-body-weight premise.
